jobs.how: Occupancy Source defaults to Always Occupied, so change it to BAS On/Off before the BAS occupancy command does anything. The shutdown point stops the unit from the network.

points.use: Write 1 = Active to shut the unit down
Read: system mode, e.g. 4 = Cooling, 5 = Heating
Read: equipment status, 1 = Disabled, 2 = Test, 3 = Run

jobs.how: Write the occupied and unoccupied heating and cooling setpoints directly, then read back the effective setpoints and the space sensor setpoint adjustment.

points.use: Read: setpoint adjustment from the space sensor

jobs.how: Trend the control values the unit is actually using. Space Temp Source tells you whether space temperature is coming from a local sensor or the network.

points.use: Read: space temperature the unit controls to
Read: indoor air quality CO2, ppm
Read: space temp source, 4 = Network, 1 = Sensor Failure

jobs.how: Read the fan relay state, the fan status input and, on VFD units, the VFD output. Fan Mode and the VFD min/max limits are writable.
Read active stage counts and each relay state, and set the OAT lockouts. If the outdoor temperature is lost, the OAT lockouts stop working.
Read economizer output and fault status, and set the minimum position, DCV and lockout values. These only matter on units with an economizer.

points.use: Write: vent / DCV minimum position (default 20 % open)
Write: DCV max control setpoint (default 650 ppm)
Write: DCV max vent damper position (default 50 %)

jobs.job: Sensor values the BMS can supply
jobs.how: Write system points at BACnet priority 16, no more than once a minute; -999 means no network value. Don't read the system point back. Read the matching control point at least 30 s later instead.

points.use: Write space temp at priority 16, max once a minute
Write OAT at priority 16; refresh or OAT alarm
Write space air quality, ppm, at priority 16
Write outdoor air quality, ppm, at priority 16
Write OA enthalpy 0 = High, 1 = Low, priority 16
Read: 4 = Network confirms the BMS space temp is used

jobs.how: Map the alarm BVs (0 = Normal, 1 = Alarm) to the BMS. The filter and runtime alarms have their own reset points.

points.use: Read: outdoor air temp sensor alarm
Write 1 = On to reset the filter alarm

checklist: Set the MS/TP MAC on rotary switches SW1 (tens) and SW2 (ones), 01-99; the device instance becomes 16101xx.
Set baud on SW3 DIP 1-2 (76.8k is the Carrier default), set the protocol DIP switches to BACnet MS/TP and the jumper to EIA-485, then power cycle.
Discover the controller, remembering that only MS/TP masters answer Who-Is.
Verify reads of MV 2002 (run_status), AV 2007 (space_temp), AV 1008 (sa_temp) and BV 2008 (occ_status).
Write MV 1002 (occ_source) = 3 BAS On/Off, then MV 1001 (keypad_ovrde) = 2 Occupied and confirm BV 2008 (occ_status) = 1.
Write AV 3001 (occ_cl_stpt) and confirm AV 3005 (eff_cl_stpt) follows.
If the BMS supplies sensors, write AV 1902 (system_spt) at priority 16 and check AV 2007 (space_temp) and MV 2003 (spt_status) at least 30 s later.
Write BV 9001 (shutdown) = 1 Active, confirm BV 2011 (shutdown_status) = 1, then write it back to 0 Inactive.
Map the BV 70xx alarms and confirm BV 7008 (sfan_fail_alarm) and BV 7024 (safety_alarm) read Normal.
